limitations: New selected modify admission state ledger: actual entry windows0/18 both mutate count and timestamp, then OR results; bothfalse returns raw186 before submission helper or admitted-count increments.
Rust owns packed-time arithmetic, saturating update, and two-window OR on nonzero periods. Invalid zero-period boundary returns error, does not emulate division fault.

Only normal selected rawclass4 flag-off branch is joined. Actual user-map insertion, class semantics, old-order mutation, post-return helper effects, queue priority, transaction rollback/durability and full modify handler remain unresolved.
No native target execution or emulation. Normal helper returns, initialized objects and nonaliasing source fields are required.
